faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about our services
faq.haveMoreQuestions: Have more questions? Don't hesitate to contact us!
faq.howToOrder: How do I order a cleaning service?
faq.howToOrderAnswer: Ordering is very simple. You can contact us by phone at +420 773 601 737, send an email to info@greenclean.cz or fill out the contact form on our website. We will respond with a price quote within 24 hours.
faq.serviceScope: What is the scope of your services?
faq.serviceScopeAnswer: We offer comprehensive cleaning services including home cleaning, office and commercial cleaning, Airbnb cleaning, furniture cleaning, post-renovation cleaning, development projects and apartment buildings. We customize each service to the individual needs of the client.
faq.priceCalculation: How is the cleaning price calculated?
faq.priceCalculationAnswer: The price is determined based on the size of the space (m²) and the type of service. We offer transparent pricing without hidden fees. For an accurate price, contact us with details about your space.
faq.ecoProducts: Do you use eco-friendly cleaning products?
faq.ecoProductsAnswer: Yes, we emphasize ecology. We use certified eco-friendly cleaning products that are gentle on the environment and your health.
faq.needToBePresent: Do I need to be present during cleaning?
faq.needToBePresentAnswer: It is not necessary. You can provide us with access to the spaces and we will perform the cleaning according to the agreed plan. Of course, you can be present if you prefer.
faq.regularCleaningAnswer: Yes, we specialize in regular cleaning of offices, apartments and other spaces. We can set up a daily, weekly or monthly schedule according to your needs.

references.title: What Our Clients Say
references.description: Customer trust and satisfaction is our priority
references.satisfactionDescription: Your satisfaction is our priority. That's why we constantly strive to improve our services and adapt to your needs.
references.testimonial1Text: We have been working with the company for several months for regular office cleaning. Everything is always neat, staff arrive on time, no complaints about quality. Very convenient that we can flexibly change the cleaning schedule.
references.testimonial2Text: I was looking for a reliable team to clean the apartment between guest stays. Everything runs quickly and without delays, the apartment is always perfectly prepared for new guests. Thanks to this I have consistently good reviews on Airbnb.
references.testimonial3Text: I ordered dry cleaning for a sofa and carpet. The result exceeded expectations and stains that seemed set-in have completely disappeared. The furniture looks like new.
references.testimonial4Text: I order regular apartment cleaning every two weeks. I really appreciate the attention to detail and careful work. After cleaning there is always a feeling of freshness and perfect cleanliness.
references.testimonial5Text: We contacted them after renovation; there was a lot of construction dust and dirt. The team did an excellent job: windows, floors, tiles - everything was thoroughly cleaned. The apartment was fully ready to move in.
references.testimonial6Text: We ordered deep cleaning of the premises before opening the café. The work was done quickly and to a very high standard. You can see they use professional equipment and products.
